after.text: # A PR labelled pi:pit-from-pr runs pi with that PR's Pit, pinned to its head commit when the job
# starts, so a change to Pit can be tried on a real thread before it is merged and released. Only

before.text: package_version=$(node --input-type=module -e 'import manifest from "./package.json" with { type: "json" }; process.stdout.write(manifest.version)')
